# Join ESIEE Paris

## Join an ESIEE Paris engineering course or an international programme

[**Engineer programmes (in french or partially in english)**](/en/apply/apply-engineer/join-esiee-paris)

[**Artificial intelligence and cybersecurity (engineering programme 100% in english)**](/en/apply/apply-engineer/master-in-artificial-intelligence-cybersecurity)

[**M.Sc Management of technology information systems (master of science 100% in english)**](/en/apply/apply-engineer/msc-management-of-technology-information-systems)

You are joining an international programme by ESIEE Paris which is 100% in English

The school's admission procedure is based on an application file, an interview and an English test.

* ### What are the prerequisites?

  Foreign students: Bachelor's degree  
   French students: First year of a Master’s degree, or equivalent  
   Each applicant must also provide evidence of a good mastery of English in their application. The minimum level required is as follows:  
   - TOEFL > 580 (PBT)/ 237 (CBT)/ 92 (IBT)  
   - TOEIC > 800  
   - IELTS level 6.5/ 7  
   - Cambridge Advanced English  
    
   These exams are not necessary if all of your secondary and higher education was in English.
* ### Admissions calendar

  Beginning of applications: 1st October 2026  
    
   Application deadline: 31st March 2027  
    
  Admission decision  
  You will receive an email about the decision made by the academic board three weeks maximum after receipt of all application documents.

  Deadline for deposit payment  
  If accepted, in order to secure your admission you will be required to pay a deposit of 6 250 €. This sum will thus be deducted from your overall tuition fees.

  Beginning of classes: 13th September 2027

**Tuition fees 2027/2028**  
  
 €10,500 for the complete programme (for complete 18-month programme)  
 €8,500 for students from partner universities (Check with your international office to see if your university has a partnership with ESIEE Paris)  
  
*Please note these fees do not include food, accommodation or living expenses.*

## How does it work?

Check out the admission requirements for your chosen programme:

* Master in Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity
* M.Sc. Management of Technology - Information systems

Prepare the documents you will need to send:

* An up-to-date CV
* Copy of your passport
* Official transcripts from all of your higher education
* Certified copy of your degree certificate(s)
* 2 letters of recommendation (use the reference form if you wish)
* Proof of English level, if necessary
* A personal statement\* outlining your motivation and aptitude for the chosen programme

*\*ensure this is your own work. Statements containing copy-paste elements will be disregarded*

[Enrol on the online admissions platform](https://esiee.moveonfr.com/form/68d544faae1421b7f80135de/eng "Opens a New window")

* [M.Sc. Management of technology information systems](/en/programmes/international-programmes/msc-management-of-technology-information-systems)

## Join an ESIEE Paris engineering course or an international programme

  Beginning of classes: late August or early September 2026

 €8 680 for the first year of the Master’s degree (E4)  
 €8 680 for the second year of the Master’s degree (E5)

# International programmes

## Find out more about our two programmes for foreign students that are also open to French students.

The aim of the international programmes is to offer high-level engineering courses taught entirely in English. They prepare students for international careers in a wide variety of exciting technological fields.

![](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAP///wAAACH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==)

## **2 programmes taught 100 % in english**

* [### Artificial intelligence and cybersecurity](/en/programmes/international-programmes/artificial-intelligence-and-cybersecurity)
* [### M.Sc. Management of technology - Information systems](/en/programmes/international-programmes/msc-management-of-technology-information-systems)

## Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity (AIC)

Degree awarded:    
Master’s degree - ESIEE Paris engineering degree - Accredited by the french Ministry for higher education and Research and the quality assurance agency Commission des Titres d'Ingénieur (CTI).

Objective  
 The Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity (AIC) programme is taught in english and trains IT engineers specialising in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

Admission requirements:   
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent (non-European students) or first year of a Master's degree or equivalent (European Union students)

[Discover the Artificial intelligence and cybersecurity programme](/en/programmes/international-programmes/artificial-intelligence-and-cybersecurity)

## M.Sc. Management of technology - Information systems (MOTIS)

Degree awarded:   
 Master of Science in Management of technology - Informations systems, accrédité par la "Conférence des Grandes Ecoles" (CGE).

Objective  
 This programme is designed to equip graduates with the skills, expertise and vision to manage advances in technology in the form of ideas, goods and services. Students will acquire the necessary technical skills and expertise in strategic issues and project management in order to manage information systems in a variety of contexts.

Admission requirements:  
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent

[Discover the M.Sc. Management of technology - Information systems](/en/programmes/international-programmes/msc-management-of-technology-information-systems)

### ESIEE Paris extends a warm welcome to all its students

Discover the services available to prepare your arrival and your time at the school.  
  
[Organising your stay at ESIEE Paris](/en/international/organising-your-stay-at-esiee-paris)

During their studies, students will have the opportunity to discover Parisian life, french culture and learn french.
